blocks:product-collection.title: Product Collection
blocks:product-collection.description: A focused commerce collection with one pastel art field, restrained status label, price, and add action per product.

blocks:product-options.title: Product Options
blocks:product-options.description: A split product decision Block composed from Story Scene, Option Selector, Quantity Stepper, and a short ruled feature list.

blocks:product-reviews-section.title: Product Reviews Section
blocks:product-reviews-section.description: Customer reviews with star ratings, verified badges, helpful voting, and load more functionality. Displays average rating summary.

blocks:size-guide.title: Size Guide
blocks:size-guide.description: Measurement chart table with chest, waist, hips, and length columns.

blocks:order-history-list.title: Order History List
blocks:order-history-list.description: Order cards with status badges, dates, and item counts with view details links.

blocks:gift-card-redemption-form.title: Gift Card Redemption
blocks:gift-card-redemption-form.description: A focused pastel redemption field composed from the shared section header, input field, button loading state, validation, and balance feedback.

blocks:back-in-stock-notification.title: Back-in-Stock Signup
blocks:back-in-stock-notification.description: A calm product-availability signup with one story field, concrete product facts, email or SMS choice, and no invented urgency.

blocks:gift-card-balance-checker.title: Gift Card Balance Checker
blocks:gift-card-balance-checker.description: Gift card management interface with balance lookup, transaction history display, and quick reload functionality.

blocks:plan-usage-summary.title: Plan Usage Summary
blocks:plan-usage-summary.description: A factual billing region with current plan, accessible usage limits, included capabilities, unavailable features, and one management route.

blocks:pricing-plans.title: Pricing Plans
blocks:pricing-plans.description: A concise three-plan comparison with one billing control, one recommended plan, sentence-case actions, and no decorative pricing variants.

blocks:build-your-own-plan.title: Build Your Own Plan
blocks:build-your-own-plan.description: Customizable pricing with base plan and selectable add-ons that update total dynamically.

blocks:plan-comparison.title: Plan Comparison
blocks:plan-comparison.description: The detailed Solo, Team, and Company feature matrix with a flat recommended column, aligned actions, real inclusion states, and square responsive plan objects on mobile.
